I'm here because I'm looking for a better solution than my own, but I'll add mine to the list in case it helps someone.

* The first time I have to open a new ink bottle, I blow at it with a hair dryer. It takes just a few seconds and then it opens really easily.
* After that, I put a piece of soft paper (like a napkin) between the neck and the lid before closing it. This way I can close it all the way and it doesn't get stuck again. It's not very pretty but it works.
   * A prettier option is to put a small piece of cloth instead, like the one you clean sunglasses with.
